0b04fa7db2.q: How can speakers and content creators maintain authentic brand reputation across speaking events and green room interactions?
0b04fa7db2.a: Being the same person online as you are in person is a huge compliment. Show up early, stay late, be genuinely grateful to organizers and attendees, follow up with personalized emails, and remember people's names. When you're paid to speak, you're the ambassador of your brand. Event planners and agencies talk to each other about which speakers are easy to work with, professional, and authentic versus those who are prima donnas or disappear after their talk.
